Style B feels most natural. The labelled actions make “Mark read,” “Archive,” and “Restore” immediately understandable; the checkbox and icon in Style C are a little too easy to misread, and Style A makes archiving look like a reading status.

I’d change the grouping before approving it, though. “Finished” and “Archived” shouldn’t be equivalent, mutually exclusive stages. A saved link can be read or unread, while archiving is a separate choice about whether it remains in my active library.

I’d prefer:

- **All**: every non-archived link, whether read or unread
- **Unread**: only links I still mean to read
- **Archived**: links I’ve put away

New saves should begin as unread. Marking one read should remove it from Unread but leave it in All. Archiving should remove it from both active views, and restoring it should preserve whether it was read or unread before. “Read” also feels more accurate than “Finished” for reference material.
